lines.text: King Solomon was taught these words by his mother, who asked what she should say to her son.
She warns him not to spend his strength on women or his vigor on those who ruin kings.
Kings should not drink wine, or they may forget what is decreed and deprive all the widows of justice.
She says to give strong drink to the perishing so he can forget his poverty.
She tells him to open his mouth for those with no voice, judge righteously, and defend the poor and needy.
